alternatives.transcript: This is a set of doctor reams agriculture lectures taken from the Killian A and B discs. These were copied from Bob Killian tape sets probably in the early two thousands. The person assigned to copy did not use a patch cable and apparently simply placed a computer mic near a tape player. The results are sometimes atrocious, but these files are not generally available to students in other ways. It is what it is. Doctor reams compiled a treasure trove of agricultural gems in his fifty year career that still is more advanced than anything else in 2017 and no doubt many decades into the future. Some of Doctor reams better organized recordings addressed to specific subjects such as foliar feeding or animal husbandry still sell for hundreds of dollars. Most listeners to these audio files will realize the wonderful gift they are. Please enjoy with the blessings of the rbti and reams agriculture communities.
